label: dropsEnd: finishExport never forwards the summary to the kernel's end, so the run started by Export never finishes
refusalIsSuccess: closeExport overrides the kernel's dismiss, so a running export closes as if the kernel had allowed it
retryRefusalIsSuccess: retryExport skips the kernel's reopen, so start is refused from finished and Try Again plans nothing
optionsOutsideEditing: setExportOptions drops its editing check, so the kernel's begin opens a closed sheet
dropsProgress: showExportProgress never forwards to the kernel's progressed
finishWhenIdle: finishExport keeps a summary the kernel's end ignores, outside a run
find:
guard case .running = exportRun else { return }
        exportSummary = summary

label: readoutDropsSummary: exportFinished shows only the kernel's written names, so the failures and Try Again's ids are lost
find: return exportSummary ?? ExportSummary(total: files.count, written: files)

label: failedReadsAsFinished: a failed kernel run reads as a finished one with no files, so the sheet shows it as done
find: guard case .finished(_, let files) = exportRun else { return nil }
replace: guard case .finished(_, let files) = exportRun else { return exportError.map { _ in ExportSummary(total: 0, written: []) } }

label: dropsError: a failed run's message is lost, so the sheet has no error to show
find: if case .failed(_, let message) = exportRun { return message }
